errors.evidence: The x-axis categories are Test1, Test2, Test3, Test4, Test5, which are ordered numerically, not alphabetically. The description is inaccurate.

errors.text_span: 在所有测试集中，浅绿色柱状图（无特征）的高度最高...各测试集的柱状图组内，四种方法的柱高顺序基本一致，即“无” > “i-vector” > “d-vector” > “s-vector”
errors.evidence: This describes a consistent trend and ranking order that is factually incorrect. For example, in Test3, the 'd-vector' bar is higher than the '无' (none) bar. The ranking of the four methods is different in almost every test set and never matches the stated order '“无” > “i-vector” > “d-vector” > “s-vector”'.
